Other changed inputs: the regenerated FEA highlighting grammar and the regenerated wasm builtin registry (fingerprint line only), which adds one field-quantity word and no execution path reads it; the empty pinned-file read in the remote filesystem providers (3af73068ba); the mode-shape legend wording in the live field scene and CLI snapshot (1e945c104a; legend text and range only); the subplot axes-slot repair in runtime plotting state (8b33ada885), which no cohort exercises; the OCCT host's per-thread STEP import table (a6fb58c3ad; the airliner cohort imports no STEP file, so its table is empty either way); the STEP exporter's direct-surface pass (d36e979417; no cohort exports STEP); and test-only edits that no cohort runs (eight OCCT CAD tests read the always-known mass-properties volume; the G128 multigrid memory test is ignored). Solver arithmetic, model inputs, dependencies, features and thresholds are unchanged. This review is not a rerun of the scientific or performance measurements.
